title: Good, but can’t keep historic data
body:
In general I really like the app, but the fact that all the historic data is deleted when you change the periodity of a task (e.g. changing the task from 2 times per week to 3 times per week) is a huge deal breaker. I only found this out when, after a few months of having a perfect record on a habit I decided to boost it from 2 to 3 times per week and found out all the historic records are gone. Sure there was some vague warning, but that doesn’t really help. 

I only recommend the app if you never plan to change the periodity of your tasks, but if you do its quite useless for keeping long term data as progress tracking in life log is not possible.
